case_verdict.notes: Main finding supported. Report admits limited inspection and has missing factory/host/lifetime/supplier coverage. Non-local-loading overstatement immediately acknowledges real local-only Settings guard, so whole paragraph is treated as qualified provisioning advice. Lower-scope cancellation is bounded by report’s explicit correct owner control. Scope-causation claim incorrectly attributes membership lease reuse to lack of generic per-tool scope enforcement. No runtime tests/external verification or deployment approval claimed. Corrected edition adds an explicit audit row for the literal operations token and its admin/approve privileges; all original verdict selections are retained.

claims.reason: No job/project-key eviction or cap. Individual member removal does exist; in this growth paragraph no eviction means tables/projects rather than denial that a subject can be discarded.

claims.report_quote: Sessions have a global capacity (`Conflict('session capacity')`) but no per-subject limit, so one credential can fill every slot and lock out everyone else.
claims.reason: Repeated opens from valid token hit global limit; expiry/close make this temporary availability risk.
